resolution: Adjust idle timeout threshold in VPN group policy configuration.

text: Laptop battery draining completely in under 30 minutes

text: Headset microphone not picking up sound during meetings

resolution: Performed hard power reset (held power button 30s) and verified 65W AC power adapter voltage.

text: Webcam hardware not detected in device manager
